definitions.explanation: A three-dimensional round shape where every point on the surface is the same distance from the center. Used in mathematics, science, and everyday descriptions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地球|ちきゅう}→地球：03461_chikyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧な{球体|きゅうたい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: The Earth is not a perfect sphere.

examples.japanese: ⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{球体|きゅうたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{反射|はんしゃ}している→反射する：19650_hanshasuru⟧。
examples.english: A glass sphere is reflecting the light.

examples.japanese: {球体|きゅうたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表面積|ひょうめんせき}→表面積：28898_hyoumenseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧4πr²⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: The surface area of a sphere can be calculated with 4πr².

notes:
The standard term for a sphere in both scientific and everyday contexts. More precise than ⟦{丸|まる}い→丸い：02967_marui⟧ (round), which can apply to flat circles as well.

FORMS:
⟦{球|きゅう}→球：28895_kyuu⟧ (ball, sphere) + ⟦{体|たい}→体：09872_tai⟧ (body, form)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {球体|きゅうたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧: spherical shape
- ⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧な{球体|きゅうたい}: perfect sphere
- {球体|きゅうたい}⟦{関節|かんせつ}→関節：09793_kansetsu⟧: ball joint
- {球体|きゅうたい}⟦{関節|かんせつ}→関節：09793_kansetsu⟧⟦{人形|にんぎょう}→人形：01487_ningyou⟧: ball-jointed doll (BJD)

- ⟦{円柱|えんちゅう}→円柱：05551_enchuu⟧: cylinder
